title: Require a separate remote callback URI on Target whenever a broker is configured
description: From the security review of #2 (finding 5). Owner: Papyrus session (target.py). Add Target.remote_callback_uri (HTTPS), required whenever broker_endpoint is set, so remote sign-in always checks the broker's redirect_uri and the approval_url's origin, including for targets whose callback_uri is a loopback URL. Then remote.py switches its two checks from callback_uri to remote_callback_uri (Cyclotron session).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Branch feature/remote-callback-uri: Target.remote_callback_uri (HTTPS), required whenever broker_endpoint is set and refused without one; features/target.feature; specs in target_test.py. After it merges, remote.py checks the broker's redirect_uri against it (Cyclotron session).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Completed: Target.remote_callback_uri landed in AnthusAI/cli-login#3 (Papyrus session); remote.py now checks the broker's redirect_uri and the approval URL's origin against it for every target, loopback or not, and refuses a remote sign-in for a target without one (fix/remote-callback-uri PR).
